title: The Empty Chair: Using AI Personas to Raise Missing Perspectives in Policy Deliberations

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative participant feedback and post-activity surveys evaluating whether AI-generated personas authentically represented missing demographic and ideological groups or risked reducing them to caricatures and misrepresentations.
Pre- and post-activity surveys measuring changes in participants' empathy, understanding, and respect toward individuals with differing or opposing political views and sustainability interests.
